description: This file defines an abstract base class for image effects in Drupal, providing common functionality and interface implementations for image effect plugins.

classes.name: ImageEffectBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing a base implementation for image effect plugins in Drupal, including configuration management, dependency handling, and effect metadata.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the plugin with configuration, ID, definition, and a logger instance.

methods.name: transformDimensions
methods.description: Method intended to modify image dimensions; default implementation does nothing.

methods.name: getDerivativeExtension
methods.description: Returns the extension for derivative images; default returns the input extension.

methods.name: getSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary array for the image effect, including label and description.

methods.name: label
methods.description: Returns the label of the image effect.

methods.name: getUuid
methods.description: Returns the UUID of the image effect.

methods.name: setWeight
methods.description: Sets the weight of the image effect.

methods.name: getWeight
methods.description: Retrieves the weight of the image effect.

methods.name: getConfiguration
methods.description: Returns the current configuration of the plugin.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the plugin configuration from an array.

methods.name: calculateDependencies
methods.description: Returns an array of dependencies; default is empty.

methods.name: onCollectionDependencyRemoval
methods.description: Handles removal of plugin when dependencies are uninstalled; returns a status.
